caption: The drawing depicts eight earrings arranged in two rows, with four earrings in each row. The top row features earrings in shades of silver and gray, including detailed front views of two earrings with ornate patterns and filigree designs, a flat back view with a scalloped edge, and a side view showing the earring’s depth and layered construction. The bottom row repeats this arrangement in tones of gold and yellow, also displaying two front views with elaborate decoration, a flat back view, and a side view, all with similar shapes and detailing as those in the top row. Each earring has a hook at the top for wearing, and there is a small, faint outline sketch of an earring in the center, uncolored and only lightly drawn. The background is plain, and the drawing focuses on accurately depicting the metallic and ornamental qualities of the earrings.
title: Earrings
